exposure: Nebulised solution of dexmedetomidine 2mcgs/kg and midazolam 0.2 mg/kg (Group DM)
Nebulised solution of ketamine 2 mg/kg and midazolam 0.2 mg/kg (Group KM)
cohort: A total of 60 children aged 2-8 years undergoing surgical procedures were randomly divided into two groups.
finding: Both nebulized ketamine with midazolam and dexmedetomidine with midazolam offer effective surgical sedation and facilitate child-parent separation, with the dexmedetomidine and midazolam combination producing the best sedation.
